item.text: Hello, I wanted to share that one of your staff members was especially helpful during my recent visit. They were welcoming, patient with my questions, and made sure my order was correct. Their calm, attentive approach made the experience more enjoyable without feeling overly formal. I thought you should know that their good service stood out and reflected well on the cafe.
